messages:
Maya: Noticed token mismatch spike after rolling out router-ttl-change. Console shows lower token usage than ledger for ~0.4% of streaming sessions.
Connor: any traces?
Maya: trace=ttl-xy-9, router=router-ttl-canary, shard=ap-south-1. Excerpt:
Maya: ```
[2026-04-28T21:14:03Z] session=ttl-xy-9 client-stream start
[2026-04-28T21:14:04Z] router handoff stable -> ttl-canary (set X-Routing-TTL=5s)
[2026-04-28T21:14:05Z] client-truncate offset=200, reconnect immediate
[2026-04-28T21:14:06Z] chunk acked offset=200 ledger_tag=lt-808 confirmed=true
[2026-04-28T21:14:06Z] chunk acked offset=200 ledger_tag=null provisional
```
Jules: looks like TTL caused ephemeral toolcall to be GC'd before ledger tag attached, producing a null-tag ack. Ledger job still records the confirmed one but console de-dupes by latest tag and drops provisional ones.
Connor: quick SQL to find similar: 
Connor: ```sql
SELECT session_id, count(*) FROM stream_acks WHERE ledger_tag IS NULL AND timestamp > '2026-04-27' GROUP BY session_id HAVING count(*)>0;
```
billing-bot: alert fired: "streaming_ttl_null_tags" rate=0.42% threshold=0.1%
Maya: mitigation options: 1) extend routing TTL for canary to avoid premature GC, 2) attach provisional tag earlier, 3) change console dedupe to prefer confirmed tags over nulls. My vote: 2 + 3 short-term.
Jules: I can patch console to treat null ledger_tag as provisional and show both provisional and confirmed counts. Also add a small reconciliation rule: if there is both null and confirmed within 2s, attribute to confirmed.
Connor: I'll add router patch to pre-attach ledger_tag on handoff and keep TTL but mark tag persistent for 10s. Pseudocode: 
Connor: ```go
if req.Header.Get("X-Routing-TTL") != "" {
  tag := allocateLedgerTag()
  req.Header.Set("X-Ledger-Tag", tag)
  req.Header.Set("X-Ledger-Tag-Persistent-Until", time.Now().Add(10*time.Second).Format(time.RFC3339))
}
```
Maya: tests needed for reconnect path and proxy header strip. Add dashboard panel "ttl_null_tag_ratio" and alert at 0.2%.
Jules: dashboard panel added, linked to INC-7720.
billing-bot: incident INC-7720 created and assigned to oncall.
Maya: timeline: console change + router preattach -> canary -> monitor 30m -> adjust. Object?
Connor: no objections. I'll open PRs now.
Jules: opening console PR. Will include notes for postmortem and runbook.
Maya: thanks team, keeping thread for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
